title: MAV-RAPA: Prospective evaluation of the efficacy of sirolimus (Rapamune) in the treatment of superficial arteriovenous malformations.
official: MAV-RAPA: Prospective evaluation of the efficacy of sirolimus (Rapamune) in the treatment of superficial arteriovenous malformations.
summary: Main objective: Reduction in the "tumour" volume of the malformation on analysis of angioscanographic changes
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients (adults, adolescents and children over 2 years of age), of stage II+, III or IV of the Schöbinger classification (1994) whether their whether the lesion is progressive or quiescent, with or without haemorrhagic phenomena.
2. Patients (parents in the case of minors) must have signed a consent form consent form drawn up after clear information about the the expected risks and benefits of the study.
3. Patients should use effective contraception for the duration of the study for the duration of the study and for up to 12 weeks after the end of treatment.
4. Negative pregnancy test (blood β-HCG) for women of childbearing age.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Acquired or chronic immunodepression
2. Anemia with Hb<9g/dl
3. Elevation of transaminases >2.5 N
4. History of cancer less than two years prior to inclusion
5. Surgery less than 2 months prior to inclusion
6. Active infection (viral and bacterial) at inclusion date
7. Hypercholesterolaemia > 7 mmol/l despite well-conducted medical treatment
8. Hyperlipidaemia > 2 mmol/l despite well-managed medical treatment
9. Uncontrolled diabetes
10. Patients unable to follow a clinical study
11. Adults under guardianship or trusteeship, persons deprived of their liberty
12. Patients with chronic active hepatitis B, hepatitis C or HIV infection
13. Pregnant or breast-feeding women.
14. Allergy to macrolides
15. Allergy to peanuts or soya
16. Hypersensitivity to 'Sirolimus' or to one of the excipients of the investigational product experimental product
17. Contraindication to the performance of an MRI scan
18. Leukopenia less than 1000 GB/mm3
19. Thrombocytopenia less than 80,000 PS/mm3
